classification.evidence_rule: REAL requires live endpoint proof, source control, deploy receipt, schema validation, monitoring, rollback proof, and ledger registration.

gap_register.finding: No GitHub-linked source path visible from Vercel metadata; deployment appears CLI-driven.
gap_register.required_level_1_control: canonical repo with branch protection and source-to-deploy trace

gap_register.finding: Publication feed is static but no enforced schema/validator visible.
gap_register.required_level_1_control: JSON schema for publications and CI validation before deploy

gap_register.finding: No approval/release workflow visible for new public comms items.
gap_register.required_level_1_control: Pen/Bridge release request with owner, approver, evidence ref, and release reason

gap_register.finding: No uptime, feed freshness, endpoint latency, or error telemetry visible.
gap_register.required_level_1_control: scheduled health checks for / and /pubs.json with receipts

gap_register.finding: Vercel rollback likely exists but no deterministic recovery receipt is present.
gap_register.required_level_1_control: documented rollback target and tested rollback receipt

gap_register.finding: No visible lifecycle states for draft, approved, published, superseded, archived.
gap_register.required_level_1_control: publication lifecycle state machine and archive-not-delete rule

gap_register.finding: Operational owner and maintainer role not encoded in the public feed or project metadata.
gap_register.required_level_1_control: owner, maintainer, escalation channel, and release authority metadata

gap_register.finding: No evidence ledger entry links comms item to source, deployment, and verification.
gap_register.required_level_1_control: audit/evidence registration for each publication and deployment

gap_register.finding: Public read is appropriate, but write/deploy authority is not externally evidenced.
gap_register.required_level_1_control: least-privilege Vercel/GitHub deploy authority and deploy-token rotation record

gap_register.finding: Feed generatedAt is static and not freshness-enforced.
gap_register.required_level_1_control: feed stale threshold, stale alert, and generatedAt verification

level_1_baseline.purpose: controlled public communications feed for Tech4Humanity
minimum_contract: all publication changes originate from canonical source or Pen job
endpoint health and feed freshness are monitored
rollback target is known and tested
each publication item has owner, brand, status, evidence_ref, version, and published_at

actions: Locate or create canonical GitHub repo for t4h-comms-hub source.
Register current /pubs.json item as baseline v1.
Write runtime receipt proving endpoint fetch, schema validation, deployment id, and feed checksum.
If repo is absent, classify source-control as PARTIAL and open remediation issue.
Do not claim REAL Level 1 until source, validation, deploy, telemetry, and receipt all exist.
bridge_instructions.close_condition: receipt exists and classifies each layer REAL/PARTIAL/MISSING
